title: Ambient tensor homology coordinates for one localized comparison
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme] with the canonical derived category and tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and $n\geq0$. Put $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and $Q=H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$. For every affine $U$, let $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I_U=\ker(i^\sharp)(U)$, $P_U$ the chosen projective resolution of $A_U/I_U$, and $T_U=P_U\otimes_{A_U}(A_U/I_U)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. There exist $A_U$-linear equivalences $d_U:H_n(T_U)\simeq\Gamma(U,Q)$ such that for every basic inclusion $V\subseteq U$, there exist a quotient map $\psi:A_U/I_U\to A_V/I_V$, an augmented chain map $a:P_U\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}P_V$, and a tensor chain map $k:T_U\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}T_V$, where $\varphi$ is ring restriction. They satisfy $\psi\circ\mathrm{mk}_{I_U}=\mathrm{mk}_{I_V}\circ\varphi$, $\pi_Va_0=\psi\pi_U$, and $k_j(x\otimes y)=a_j(x)\otimes\psi(y)$. For this one comparison, $\operatorname{res}_{U,V}(d_U(x))=d_V(e(H_n(k)(x)))$ for every $x$, where $e$ is the exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism. This statement makes no assertion about other lifts or about algebraic Tor coordinates.

proof.text: Choose a global K-flat resolution q:K→B[0] using exists_isKFlatResolution. Apply the natural K-flat derived tensor comparison to the two constant singleton families K and B[0]. The image of q under Q is invertible; tensor it with the identity of B[0] and compose with the comparison. Apply the derived homology functor and homologyFunctorFactors. Taking the inverse gives a genuine isomorphism from H^{-n}(Tot(K tensor B[0])) to the ambient derived tensor homology Q.

Apply exists_selfTor_ordinary_resolution_sections to K,q and n. Compose each ordinary affine coordinate d_U with the sectionwise linear equivalence induced by the preceding sheaf homology isomorphism. This constructs c_U without choosing any object or morphism in a definition.

For a basic inclusion V⊆U, ideal_le_comap_ideal shows that ring restriction carries I_U into I_V. Apply the already-proved exists_quotient_resolution_tensor_comparison to the two chosen quotient resolutions; it constructs psi,a,k and all three required equations, without localization or flatness assumptions. Apply the ordinary coordinate naturality to these lifts. Naturality of the sheaf homology isomorphism transports the equation to c_U and c_V.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_selfTor_ambient_localized_comparisons
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q :=
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    ∃ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
            (projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
              ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)]
              Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
          let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          let C := (Γ(Y, V.1) : Type u)
          let I := i.ker.ideal U
          let J := i.ker.ideal V
          let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
          let P := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))
          let R := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))
          let TA := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          let TC := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          ∃ (ψ : (A ⧸ I) →+* (C ⧸ J))
            (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj R.complex)
            (k : TA.obj P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj (TC.obj R.complex)),
            (∀ x : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (φ x)) ∧
            (∀ x : P.complex.X 0, R.π.f 0 (a.f 0 x) = ψ (P.π.f 0 x)) ∧
            (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : P.complex.X j) (y : A ⧸ I),
              k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = (show R.complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[C] (ψ y)) ∧
            let e := ((TC.obj R.complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)
          ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op (c U x) =
            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))
